method: Execute the frozen actual cleanup block with fake ADB/collector commands and real isolated sleep processes; send SIGTERM to only the fixture process group.
limits: This is an actual-shell cancellation probe, not a GitHub cancellation or real emulator run.
The collector gate-exit argument is the incoming EXIT trap status. It can be zero during signal termination and does not establish the final process/workflow outcome.
SIGKILL cannot guarantee cleanup or diagnostic retention and was not claimed.
